claims.claim_ar: حرف التوكيد/الإظهار (مثال: وَأَنَّ/وَإِنَّ) يُقْرَأُ بِفَتْحِ هَمْزته في القراءة الاعتيادية.
claims.claim_en: The particle (e.g., وَأَنَّ / وَإِنَّ) is read with the hamza pronounced with a fatḥ (an opening vowel on the hamza) in the common reading.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source example uses وَأَنَّ explicitly; the ayah has وَإِنَّ. The reading is being applied analogically from the example rather than the exact cited phrase.

claims.claim_ar: يجوز قراءة همزة «إن/أن» بكسرها عند الوقف أو على الاستئناف (أي: تُكسر همزتها في حالة الاستئناف).
claims.claim_en: It is permissible to read the hamza of 'إن/أن' with a kasra (i.e., with a kasra on the hamza) when occurring on isti'naf (resumption/continuation).
claims.needs_review_reason: The statement in the source refers to the example وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ; application to وَإِنَّ in this ayah is by analogy and should be checked against explicit discussion of this exact formula.

claims.source_quote_ar: تَقْدِيرُهُ: ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَكُ مُغَيِّرًا، وَبِأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ،
claims.claim_ar: تقدير العبارة (أي المعنى المختزل) يُذكَر على صورة: «ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّ ...»؛ أي أن جملة إنّ يُفهم معها تقدير (ذلك) في المعنى التوجيهي/البياني.
claims.claim_en: The estimated (implied) wording is given as 'ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّ ...' — i.e., the clause introduced by إنّ is understood with an implied 'ذلك' (that/this) supplying the explanatory force of the statement.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source explicitly gives this تقدير for the example وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ; applying the same type of تقدير to وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ in the ayah is plausible but not explicitly stated in the chunk provided.
